svg.title: Nova Aurelia
svg.desc: A detailed animated oblique architectural illustration of Nova Aurelia, with the Grand Sovereign Pyramid, Sky City Zenith Spire, Infinity Tower, World Government Center, Royal Clock Tower, Roman sun temple, ceremonial avenue, Spiral Lighthouse, Olympic stadium, spaceport, Palm Island, World Isles and Chameleon Atolls. Conceptual city geography.
